acceptance: A fixture with the real lane commit message shape reads as landed
A composed commit still reads as landed through its trailer
fix: Design first. Read ancestry first for a lane commit. Keep CheckLanded for composed commits.

summary: laneLanded needs an evolve-cycle N subject or an Evolve-Cycle trailer. Real lane commits read evolve-cycle: goal=<hash> with no trailer. A probe found 0 of 11 real records reading as landed while 8 were ancestors of origin/main. The same trap reaches landedByIdentity at postship.go.
title: CheckLanded cannot identify a lane commit that landed by itself
